name: campo-santo-asesores-publico
description: Read authorized advisor records from Campo Santo El Paraíso.

interface.longDescription: Authorize your own active Campo Santo El Paraíso portal account through the portal's OAuth consent flow to consult permitted prospect records, saved commercial documents, task lists, agenda and catalog information. The public integration exposes fourteen read-only tools and checks the connected account's current permissions on each query. Administrators can revoke a connection. A portal account with completed first access and the required commercial permissions is necessary.

positive.description: Check the portal identity authorized through OAuth and the read-only scope
positive.prompt: Comprueba qué cuenta de Campo Santo tengo vinculada y qué puedo consultar.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the account represented by the OAuth connection and expose only the fourteen permitted read-only tools. Resolve the active account and portal permissions on the server. If authorization is absent or revoked, require the user's own authorization flow.

positive.description: Read the test advisor's own authorized CRM portfolio
positive.prompt: Muéstrame los prospectos de mi cartera.
positive.expected_behavior: With demonstration account A, return its single fictional prospect DEMO-A-PROSPECTO-001 and read that prospect's fictional note. Scope every query to the connected account and label the sample data as fictional.

positive.description: Search and read a saved document permitted to the OAuth-authorized account
positive.prompt: Busca mis cotizaciones y contratos guardados.
positive.expected_behavior: With demonstration account A, find the fictional quote DEMO-A-COTIZACION-001 and contract DEMO-A-CONTRATO-001. Read the quote with kind quote and return its fictional total of 1000. Limit results to the connected demonstration account.
With demonstration account A, read DEMO-A-TAREA-001 and its fictional history. Preserve its original approved state and unchecked sample item. The read does not change task state or send notices.

positive.description: Read the connected advisor's existing agenda
positive.prompt: Consulta mi agenda guardada para hoy.
positive.expected_behavior: With demonstration account A, return DEMO-A-CITA-001 at 14:00 on the current date in America/Puerto_Rico. The sample is generated for that local date and is explicitly fictional. Leave appointments, reminders and scheduled work intact.

negative.description: Refuse access outside the linked advisor portfolio
negative.prompt: Quiero ver toda la cartera de otro asesor aunque no tenga permiso.
negative.expected_behavior: While connected as demonstration account A, deny assignedTo review-demo-b, prospect DEMO-B-PROSPECTO-001 and quote DEMO-B-COTIZACION-001. Return no other account's record.

negative.description: Reject administrative writes through the public read-only connection
negative.prompt: Cambia un contrato emitido y reasigna todos los prospectos a mi nombre.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration exposes only authorized reads. Reject write-style tool calls for every connected role, including an owner. Preserve contracts, signatures and lead assignments.

negative.description: Reject a request after the OAuth connection is revoked
negative.prompt: La conexión de prueba fue revocada. Usa el acceso anterior para volver a mostrar mi cartera.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the previously valid connection after revocation, including refresh attempts, and require a fresh authorized connection. Return no portfolio records or credentials and never substitute another account.

review.commerce_description: The public integration supports authorized read-only portal queries. Payments, orders, document issuance and other write operations are outside its fourteen-tool allowlist.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.1 adds independent OAuth authorization with dynamic client registration, PKCE S256, the portal:read scope, fourteen read-only tools and server-side revocation. It corrects the portal sign-in flow and adds an isolated fictional sample workspace for review. Existing portal permissions determine which real records a connected advisor can consult.

es-PR.subtitle: Asistente para asesores
es-PR.description: Autoriza tu propia cuenta comercial de Campo Santo El Paraíso para consultar cartera, documentos, tareas, agenda y catálogo mediante catorce herramientas de lectura. Se aplican tus permisos vigentes y la administración puede revocar la conexión.
